change: Notches and auxiliary lines: a notch tool (by distance or where the line is clicked), an auxiliary-line tool and a delete-auxiliary-lines command, four new commands and assistant phrases; notches and auxiliary lines are read from ET files of the 2.0 (08) layout and written back, and every line of an opened ET file is carried. Includes v51 (cut, stepped and fold-back seam corners) and v50 (an opened ET file becomes an editable project that is saved as a complete ET PRJ).
validation: Node tests, 15 real-browser suites, notch records compared with the ones ET 2017 writes with its own notch tool, auxiliary lines deleted by ET 2017 with its own command, an ET 2017 round trip of a file with notches and auxiliary lines made in the browser, and two real ET patterns with 668 lines, 31 pieces, 17 treated corners and 42 notches converted, written back, opened, re-saved and refreshed by ET 2017 and compared with the originals
limits: Notches placed by a size of the size table become fixed; dashed stitch lines along edges become plain dashed lines; the two halves of a symmetric piece are no longer linked; copying notches is missing; of ET element attributes only the auxiliary line is supported; grading rules and sizes are not carried; files of the 3.0 and 5.0 layouts must first be saved as 08 in ET; only two real patterns were compared; no model service is included and no key is shipped
